_comment: Hosts an agent in the box may reach on port 443 through the gate's CONNECT proxy — its own LOGIN only. Model calls go through the LLM proxy, so no model API host is listed (api.anthropic.com, api.githubcopilot.com, …): listing one would let the agent call models around the proxy. Exact names, no wildcards. Changing this file changes the guard digest: rebuild with `coding box build`. Refused hosts are summarised when a box exits.
